==English==

===Alternative forms===
* {{alt|en|mon.||abbreviation}}

===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|en|/ˈmʌnθli/}}
* {{audio|en|en-us-monthly.ogg|a=US}}
* {{rhymes|en|ʌnθli|s=2}}

===Etymology 1===
From {{af|en|month|-ly|id2=adjectival|pos2=adjectival suffix}}, perhaps via {{inh|en|enm|*monethly}} (attested only adverbially), from {{inh|en|ang|mōnaþlīċ|t=monthly}}, from {{inh|en|gmw-pro|*mānōþlīk}}, from {{inh|en|gem-pro|*mēnōþlīkaz|t=monthly}}. Cognate with {{cog|stq|moundelk|t=monthly}}, {{cog|de|monatlich|t=monthly}}, {{cog|da|månedlig|t=monthly}}, {{cog|sv|månatlig|t=monthly}}, {{cog|nb|månedlig|t=monthly}}, {{cog|is|mánaðarlegur|t=monthly}}.

====Adjective====
{{en-adj|-}}

# Occurring every [[month]].
#: {{ux|en|It's time give the dog its '''monthly''' bath.}}

|passage=Of the 10 '''monthlies''' with the worst declines in January, four were Condé Nast magazines: Wired, Architectural Digest, Vogue and Lucky.|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20230221013135/https://www.nytimes.com/2009/01/05/business/media/05adco.html|archivedate=21 February 2023}}

|passage=Katherine assumed she was having her '''monthly'''. She could recall times when her own '''monthly''' was so intense that it showed on her face.}}
